scope: Bounded economic-function inspection of four pinned public repositories and the five named Ascension contracts. No fresh contract tests, chain calls, transactions or financial scenario evaluation.

status_definitions.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED: Economic behavior read in pinned source; this amendment did not execute it.
status_definitions.TEST_SOURCE_INSPECTED_NOT_RUN: Test code inspected; neither execution nor PASS inferred.
status_definitions.REPORTED_HISTORICAL_DEPLOYMENT: Project-maintained dated attestation inspected; no independent current-chain validation.
status_definitions.PROPOSED_NOT_IMPLEMENTED_BY_INSPECTED_CO: Commercial arrangement or reinvestment policy that requires separate adoption.

units.gas: ETH, separate unspecified price/cost; no new transaction performed

flows.custodian: Chosen commercial collection provider, if any
flows.recipients: Named supplier and separately contracted collection/tax counterparties
flows.mechanism: Proposed invoice price less explicitly assumed collection charges and refunds; no inspected repository enforces this commercial arrangement.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Processor fees, refund terms and any deposits must be supplied prospectively; no implicit zero fee.
flows.authority: A named enterprise decision-maker would approve surplus appropriations after costs, reserves and liabilities.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Proposed enterprise policy only; no automatic token demand or 50% reinvestment.

flows.mechanism: createJob receives exact payout P, freezes validator percentage and records escrow.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Employer funds gross payout; agent, validators and disputant separately provide their own bonds.
flows.authority: Constructor selects explicit governor; intake begins paused; role and policy controls govern admission.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Escrow is an obligation, not supplier profit or free treasury cash.

flows.recipients: Correct-side validators; wallet30; wallet10; assigned agent
flows.mechanism: V=floor(P*v/100) when votes exist; W30=floor(30P/100); W10=floor(10P/100); agent=P-V-W30-W10 plus unallocated validator pool. Default v=8, with no-vote authorized completion using V=0.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: No AGIALPHA burn or swap. Bond return and forfeiture transfers are separate from customer-paid award. Failed token sends become reserved beneficiary claims.
flows.authority: Posting-time validator rate; wallet rotation only owner with paused intake and zero live escrow/bond reserves; deferred claims retain original beneficiary.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Only a legally/economically identified recipient's actual receipt can enter its revenue account; wallet names do not prove ownership.

references.symbol: split / snapshots / refunds / deferred claim tests

flows.recipients: Employer refund, appropriate bond owners and correct reviewers
flows.mechanism: Employer-win refund restores full buyer escrow, funds reviewer rewards from forfeited agent bond, and sends remaining collateral/residue to employer. Neutral unanswered arbitration returns escrow and all bonds. Assigned expiry returns escrow and transfers agent bond to employer.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: No wallet30/wallet10 successful-job shares from refunds. No commit-reveal non-reveal penalty. Agent and validator bond formulas include caps; agent formula also has duration premium.
flows.authority: Source-defined cancellation, deadline, dispute and settlement-pause conditions.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Refund liabilities and beneficiary claims are unavailable for discretionary investment.

flows.asset: No payment in these two contracts; ERC721 seed ownership
flows.payer: No token transfer in inspected Access or NovaSeed functions
flows.custodian: Access role/admission records; NovaSeed immutable plan and metadata
flows.mechanism: Current ENS ownership plus expiring owner-issued admission; business-owned seed commits capsule, evidence, parent and immutable plan root.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: No inherent royalty, dividend or buyback.
flows.authority: Access owner controls admission; seed ownership and admitted business role govern downstream operations.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: A seed is not evidence of corporate equity or legal IP rights. It constrains a downstream plan; it is not spendable cash.

flows.mechanism: Deposit canonical AGIALPHA; eligibility requires minimum constructor stake and live identity; review and marketplace reservations lock stake and capacity.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: No direct validator yield or slashing function in RiskOracle. JobMarket payout is a separate operation.
flows.authority: Governor binds marketplace once; admitted validator publishes availability; eligible seed owner requests bounded risk review.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Stake remains committed working capital, not revenue or a cost per successful job absent a loss/opportunity-cost model.

flows.payer: Business directly or MARK reserve on its behalf
flows.recipients: Worker and two approving validators; token supply burn; original-client remainder
flows.mechanism: Bounty B escrowed; winning price P<=B. e=floor(floor(P*500/10000)/2), worker gross=P-2e. Each recipient's gross payout separately burns floor(gross/100). B-P is claimable by original client.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Worker bond=max(floor(B/10),minimumStake), locked from deposited stake. Successful bond unlock is not revenue.
flows.authority: Admitted ENS business/agent/validators; selected three-person committee; two eligible approvals; one-time MARK binding.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Worker net token receipts may be revenue to its identified operator; usable USD requires separate realized conversion, liquidity and spending authority.

flows.payer: Escrow and worker bond on slashable failure
flows.mechanism: Two eligible rejections or assigned non-submission by due: full B refund plus bond less floor(bond/100); worker loses full bond. Submitted result with missing review quorum: full B refund and worker bond unlock without slash. No valid winning bid refunds B.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Direct votes, not commit/reveal. A missing quorum is not itself proof of failed delivered work.
flows.authority: Bounded deadlines and source-state transitions; original client claims once; MARK can collect its own refund.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Slash receipts are penalties, not stable customer revenue. Refunded client capital cannot be counted as earned profit.

flows.recipients: Campaign reserve; funder on permitted sell
flows.mechanism: buy receives tokens on a bounded pricing curve and credits lots. During Funding, sell returns curve value and reduces lots/reserve; transferLots is limited by phase, time and admission.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Capital contribution, not customer job revenue. Lots are campaign accounting claims, not an externally guaranteed liquid equity token.
flows.authority: Opening requires eligible seed owner and green review; selling unused funding remains possible despite revoked admission or expired risk status.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Reserve is purpose-restricted contributed capital, not free retained earnings.

flows.recipients: JobMarket workers/validators on accepted jobs; remaining reserve to lot holders after close
flows.mechanism: Business blooms and routes only immutable-plan Merkle-proved job indices within reserve and horizon; refunds return via collect. On close, each lot holder reclaims floor(reserve*holderLots/totalLots), then its lots are removed.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: No external-enterprise-profit intake/distribution, no buyback, no automatic revenue recycling or 50% appropriation. JobMarket burn occurs downstream.
flows.authority: Named original business must remain seed owner with same admitted ENS identity and green review; plan proof/index prevents arbitrary spend or replay.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Unused-capital redemption is not a claim on external profits; plan-authorized construction is possible only within separately funded/approved scope.

flows.payer: Employer reward R plus separately calculated fee F
flows.custodian: StakeManager job escrow and distinct operator reward pool
flows.mechanism: F=floor(R*f/100), P=R+F. V=floor(R*v/100) when validators exist; worker modified amount M=floor((R-V)*m/100); worker net=M-floor(M*b/100). FeePool separately processes F. Extra M-(R-V), when positive, must be covered by existing operatorRewardPool.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Posting snapshots fee and job stake; application snapshots worker payout percentage. Validator percentage and worker burn are read at settlement. Validator allocation is weight-based with rounding residue to highest weight.
flows.authority: Configured registry/modules, role identity and tax acknowledgements, sufficient stake, pause and blacklist conditions; governance-only fund/withdraw operator reward pool.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: A payout boost consumes prefunded capital and does not create revenue. Ship defaults are templates, not live configuration.

flows.payer: Failed-job escrow and independently slashed role stakes
flows.recipients: Configured employer / treasury / operator / validator shares and burn
flows.mechanism: Failed finalization and assigned timeout redistribute reward+fee under configured penalty shares and separately slash job stake. Unassigned cancellation instead refunds full reward+fee. No-quorum force-finalize records failed state for later settlement. Non-reveal and wrong-outcome review penalties apply separately.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: Source defaults: validator non-reveal 50bps of snapshot stake plus 7200-block ban; wrong-outcome vote 50% stake. Job stake=ceil(R*jobStakeBps/10000). Config example 50/50 employer/treasury is penalty distribution, not reinvestment.
flows.authority: Owner-adjustable review parameters, governance-defined distributions, eligible/locked stake and source phase/deadline conditions.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: A full-buyer-refund assumption is invalid for the general failed route. Numerical failed-route economics NOT MODELED unless every relevant parameter and branch is frozen.

flows.payer: Job fees transferred by StakeManager; separate voluntary contributors
flows.recipients: Burn, configured boosted-stake role claimants, limited treasury dust
flows.mechanism: Burn floor(F*d/100), then pendingFees+=F-burn. Distribute over boosted stake in configured rewardRole (default Platform). If total stake is zero, burn pending amount; dust goes to allowed treasury or burns. Claims depend on role stake, multiplier and accumulator.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: FeePool burn is additional to and has a different denominator from worker-payout burn. Direct contributions are capital inflows, not additional customer earnings.
flows.authority: Owner sets role, burn, allowed treasury and rewarders; governance-only withdrawal target is configured treasury or burn address.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Eligible staker fee rights are not an entitlement for all passive tokenholders, fixed yield, or enterprise-profit share. Permissioned treasury withdrawal is not automatic appropriation.

flows.asset: USDC or AGIALPHA retained as explicit planning context
flows.payer: No payment created by the inspected offline project journey
flows.recipients: Requested report and internal check; no automatic contract settlement
flows.mechanism: Existing source preserves separate Agent and Node authorizations, STOP/recovery and complete task/history return. Selected contract profiles bind exact graphs; local profile tests use mock USDC.
flows.fees_burns_collateral: No additional universal Fleet platform fee established; no automatic currency conversion or private-work settlement.
flows.authority: Explicit scoped local authorization and separate funded-operation commissioning; productionQualified remains false in the source preview.
flows.reinvestment_meaning: Useful execution evidence is not revenue, current deployment authorization or an enterprise treasury bridge.

not_established: Current active deployed behavior or current state
Ownership of fee wallets by the modeled enterprise
Current customer demand, collections or retained earnings
Universal tokenholder revenue sharing or redemption
Token valuation, liquidation depth or spendable USD from unconverted tokens
Independent security audit or production commissioning
accounting_rules: Identify the enterprise's receiving role and beneficiary before recognizing a receipt.
Keep customer escrow, contributed capital, reserves, returned collateral and slashed collateral separate from ordinary operating revenue.
A token burn is destruction of token units, not cash income or proof of price appreciation.
Recognize reinvestable resources only after expenses, taxes, refunds, obligations, reserves and separately authorized appropriation.
Use exact atomic-unit integer formulas; label continuous ratios as approximations.
Do not merge Manager USDC and Jobs/Ascension AGIALPHA assets or fee conventions.
